title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards — Held-Capture Cap by Card Spend at Marlowe & Finch (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Cap rule.** On a refund of a second capture of a Merchandise Purchases unit's payment, a customer whose Marlowe & Finch purchases charged to a Marlowe & Finch card in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchases whose transaction date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reach the upper held-capture spend threshold of $1500.00 has the upper held-capture cap of $10.00; one whose such purchases reach the middle held-capture spend threshold of $500.00 but not the upper has the middle held-capture cap of $5.00. A customer whose such purchases total less than $500.00 is outside this rule.

The purchases are the purchase transactions at Marlowe & Finch on the customer's Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards accounts.

| Card purchases at Marlowe & Finch, past twelve months (hypothetical) | Held-capture cap |
|---|---|
| $1500.00 | $10.00 |
| $1499.99 | $5.00 |
| $500.00 | $5.00 |
| $499.99 | outside this rule |
